entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Hero given a Legacy of great power, who goes to Rath to rescue his captain.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Flying ship crewed by Gerrard and his friends.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Lord of the plane of Rath, who captured Gerrard's captain.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Fierce leader of Volrath's forces who boards the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Vec
entities.description: Allies who help Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Skyshroud Elves
entities.description: Allies who help Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane whose future is at stake.

events.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight above the Plains of Rath and Greven il-Vec's forces board her to steal Gerrard's legacy.
events.quote: Volrath's forces, led by the fierce Greven il-Vec , board the Weatherlight in an attempt to steal Gerrard's mysterious legacy.

events.summary: Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew, helped by the Vec and Skyshroud Elves, head toward Volrath's fortress to save captured shipmates.
events.quote: With the help of new allies, the Vec and the Skyshroud Elves , Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew begin the treacherous path towards Volrath's fortress .

relations.note: Gerrard must rescue his captain from Volrath.
relations.quote: his captain , has been captured by the forces of Volrath , lord of the plane of Rath
